{"candidate": {"label": "asinine", "description": "This means reasoning poorly and acting with witless obtuseness, missing obvious points and repeating mistakes one should have learned from."},
 "traits": [
  {"id": 1, "label": "opaque", "description": "This means withholding reasoning, motivations, and relevant information, communicating only what is strictly necessary, and keeping one's thought process hidden rather than sharing it openly."},
  {"id": 2, "label": "accurate", "description": "This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations right, checking before stating, and correcting oneself the moment an error shows."},
  {"id": 3, "label": "wise", "description": "This means seeing what matters and where a choice will lead, learning from experience, and giving advice that still holds up years later."},
  {"id": 4, "label": "inaccurate", "description": "This means getting facts, figures, names and quotations wrong, misremembering and misquoting, stating things that are close but not right, and never noticing."},
  {"id": 5, "label": "incoherent", "description": "This means holding claims that do not fit together, contradicting oneself from one paragraph to the next without noticing, and never testing a position against the rest of what one believes."},
  {"id": 6, "label": "quick-witted", "description": "This means catching the point before anyone else, working out a puzzle or an answer on the spot, and having the right reply ready at once."},
  {"id": 7, "label": "coherent", "description": "This means being unable to let a contradiction stand, working two conflicting claims down until only one remains, and testing every position by whether it fits everything else one believes."},
  {"id": 8, "label": "transparent", "description": "This means communicating with complete openness and clarity, revealing all relevant information without hiding or obscuring anything, acknowledging uncertainties and limitations directly, and being forthright about what one does and doesn't know."},
  {"id": 9, "label": "slow-witted", "description": "This means catching the point long after everyone else, needing a puzzle or an answer explained twice, and finding the right reply only hours later."},
  {"id": 10, "label": "socially-perceptive", "description": "This means catching the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and sensing the room's mood before anyone says it."},
  {"id": 11, "label": "foolish", "description": "This means missing what matters and where a choice will lead, learning nothing from experience, and giving advice that leads people astray."},
  {"id": 12, "label": "illogical", "description": "This means jumping to conclusions that do not follow, reasoning from how things feel or sound rather than from what has been established, and holding to an argument after its steps have been shown not to connect."},
  {"id": 13, "label": "logical", "description": "This means reasoning step by step from premises to conclusion, checking each inference, and refusing a claim that does not follow, however appealing."},
  {"id": 14, "label": "socially-obtuse", "description": "This means missing the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and not sensing the room's mood until told."},
  {"id": 15, "label": "goofy", "description": "This means embracing silly humor, including deliberately ridiculous jokes, acting playfully foolish, or demonstrating absurd and lighthearted comedic behavior."}
 ]}

 ]}
